scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/esign-core -w packages/esign-node -w packages/esign-react-native -w packages/esign-react -w examples/react-native-demo -w examples/react-demo -w examples/full-service-demo -w examples/mint-only-demo -w examples/serverless-handler-demo -w scripts
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w packages/esign-core -w packages/esign-node -w packages/esign-react-native -w packages/esign-react -w examples/react-native-demo -w examples/react-demo && npm run test -w examples/full-service-demo -- --coverage && npm run test:coverage -w examples/mint-only-demo -w examples/serverless-handler-demo -w scripts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/esign-core -w packages/esign-node -w packages/esign-react-native -w packages/esign-react -w examples/react-native-demo -w examples/react-demo -w examples/full-service-demo -w examples/mint-only-demo -w examples/serverless-handler-demo
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/esign-core -w packages/esign-node -w packages/esign-react-native -w packages/esign-react
scripts.check:packages: publint packages/esign-core && publint packages/esign-node && publint packages/esign-react-native && publint packages/esign-react && attw --pack packages/esign-core --profile node16 && attw --pack packages/esign-node --profile node16 && attw --pack packages/esign-react --profile node16
scripts.codegen: npm run schema:emit -w examples/full-service-demo && npm run codegen -w packages/esign-core
